entries.label: depth.FirstShores.share
entries.description: Share of main-landmass land assigned to the first (outermost) depth stratum. The shares of a set must complete 1.

entries.label: depth.WildReaches.share
entries.description: Share of main-landmass land assigned to the middle depth stratum. The shares of a set must complete 1.

entries.label: depth.AncientInteriors.share
entries.description: Share of main-landmass land assigned to the last (innermost) depth stratum. The shares of a set must complete 1.

entries.label: depth.AncientInteriors.min_coast_depth
entries.description: Minimum distance in cells from the coast for a cell to be in this stratum; a closer cell falls to the previous stratum.

entries.label: ordered
entries.description: True when the strata are ordered from first to last.

entries.label: type
entries.description: How cells are assigned to strata (for example coast_cost_bands).

entries.label: metric
entries.description: Cell metric the assigner reads (for example coast_cost).

entries.label: name
entries.description: Stratum name, unique within its set.

entries.label: share
entries.description: Share of the cells the stratum takes, 0 to 1.

entries.label: regions_min
entries.description: Minimum regions generated in the stratum.

entries.label: regions_max
entries.description: Maximum regions generated in the stratum.

entries.label: main_landmass_only
entries.description: Restrict the stratum to the main landmass.

entries.label: min_coast_depth
entries.description: Minimum coast depth a cell needs to join the stratum.
